description: Unit test for the ModifyAcl class, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception cases within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.modify package.

classes.name: ModifyAclTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ModifyAcl class behaviors such as immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ModifyAcl class and related objects are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations in ModifyAcl.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyAcl instance with a null ThingId string throws a ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyAcl instance with a null ThingId object throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAcl
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyAcl instance with a null AccessControlList throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method of ModifyAcl produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creation of ModifyAcl instance from valid JSON and checks its fields.
